note: Starting vault for the demo brand, Acme Savings. Every item is invented for the demo: no real company, person, place or figure. Imported once on an empty database; edit or delete in the app afterwards.

vault.title: Groups on Acme Savings
vault.body: 1,200+ savings groups keep their records on Acme Savings (demo figure).

vault.title: Deposits recorded
vault.body: More than 85,000 deposits were recorded on Acme Savings last year (demo figure).

vault.title: Members saving weekly
vault.body: 9,400+ members save every week through their groups on Acme Savings (demo figure).

vault.title: What a savings group is
vault.body: A savings group is a circle of people who put in a fixed amount on a fixed day. The pot is kept for the group, and each member can see what they have put in.
vault.sourceNote: General explanation written for the demo.

vault.title: Paper records
vault.body: Many groups still keep one paper book. When that book is lost or damaged, the group loses its only record of who paid what.
vault.sourceNote: General explanation written for the demo.

vault.title: Free plan
vault.body: Acme Savings has a free plan for groups of up to 30 members.

vault.title: Deposit records
vault.body: Each deposit is recorded with the member, the amount, the date and who took it. Members see their own record on their phone the same day.

vault.title: Group goals
vault.body: A group can set a shared goal, such as a target for the end of the year, and everyone sees how close it is.

vault.title: Two-person approval
vault.body: A payout needs a second person in the group to approve it before it is recorded as paid.

vault.title: Monthly statements
vault.body: At the end of each month every member gets a short statement of what they put in and what the group holds.

vault.title: Harbour Street Savers join
vault.body: Harbour Street Savers, an invented weekly group of 24 members, moved its records from a paper book to Acme Savings.

vault.title: Community savings day
vault.body: Acme Savings holds an open afternoon for group treasurers on the last Saturday of January (demo event).

vault.title: Planned features (internal)
vault.body: An example of an internal note: plans that are not public yet. The tag not-for-posts tells reviewers to keep it out of posts.
